title: The two cubic separable minimal surfaces: $\mathcal D_1\mathcal D_2\mathcal D_3=1$ and $\mathcal C_1+\mathcal C_2+\mathcal C_3=3\,\mathcal C_1\mathcal C_2\mathcal C_3$
summary: A minimal surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ is $\textit{separable}$ if it is the zero set of $f(x)+g(y)+h(z)$, and $\textit{isotropic}$ if moreover $f=g=h$. We announce that there are exactly two non-planar isotropic separable minimal surfaces up to homothety and rigid motion, that they are conjugate, and that they are Schwarz's diamond surface $\mathrm{D}$ and Schwarz's primitive surface $\mathrm{P}$.
